core_train_reference.meaning: Existing approved experimental reference, not an expanded or newly trained dataset

protected_development.meaning: Repeatedly used development data; protected from training/pretraining, never a new blind test

retired_evaluation_reference.meaning: Old evaluation-role history retained, not next-study independent evaluation. May be reviewed as training candidates only after quality/mapping/active-isolation gates. No automatic promotion.

historical_source_candidate.meaning: Historical source, not automatically approved training evidence

auxiliary_source_candidate.meaning: Comparative evidence needs provenance, mapping, supervision scope and active-holdout isolation; separate from experimental gold

future_independent_test.meaning: Reserve reviewed whole groups before use; keep separate from training/pretraining and development

relations: known family/clan/homology under declared review scope
primary study and repeated structure under declared grouping

invariant_quality_rules: Probing profile is not pair-partner truth
Comparative labels are separate auxiliary evidence
Historical scores never become new independent validation

claims.development_track: Controlled development evidence on protected groups only; no unbiased generalization claim
claims.confirmatory_track: Requires separately reviewed and frozen independent experimental groups not used for selection
claims.new_test_not_required_for_bounded_develo: Development experiments may be designed after data/runtime gates, explicitly without new independent validation
claims.old_test_score_reuse: Prohibited as evidence for models whose training or design used those targets or relatives

next_action: Re-review the same three family candidates against active development and future test roles. Preserve their old pilot exclusions as correct under the old policy. Source, mapping and active isolation must pass before representatives are selected.
